title: Hardware bringup diagnostics: firmware self-test and anomaly detection
description: Add a lichen_diag module that detects common hardware bringup failures at runtime and reports structured diagnostics via CoAP GET /diag and UART console. Each subsystem hooks into the diagnostic ring with specific anomaly detectors. Goal: first-boot on a new board tells you exactly what's wrong instead of silently failing. Covers: radio (SX1262 SPI/GPIO/PA/TCXO), GPS (UART/fix/PPS), display (SPI contention), power (ADC cal/drain), and fleet-level (clock drift, asymmetric links, version skew).
